text:
maria: Quick check — need confirmation on console observability handoff timeline. Dashboards + trace hooks + error-analysis view need final owners and a retention plan before EOW. My proposal: dashboards -> alex, trace hooks -> ben, error analysis -> priya. Retention proposal: 90 days hot, 365 days archived. Any objections?
ben: I'm fine owning trace hooks. Need SRE signoff on retention numbers though. @carla can you confirm we can support 90/365 without infra changes?
carla: 90/365 looks ok in staging. Prod will need cold-storage + compacting after ~180 unless we change retention tiering. I'll post rough cost numbers in a sec.
maria: can you paste the rough numbers here for the doc? finance wants a ballpark.
carla: quick ballpark: current token rate ~1.2M tokens/day -> ~3TB/mo raw traces. 90 days hot ~= 9TB, 365 archived ~= 36TB. Cost estimate: ~$2.5k/mo for hot, ~$6k/mo for archive on current provider. Will refine with storage class breakdown.
alex: I can take dashboards. Do we have a template for the error-analysis view that priya can reuse? @ben any query patterns we should expose from traces?
ben: need per-route error counts, grouped stack traces (top-5), and latency percentiles. I'll sketch a query proto and post it. Keep the widget set minimal first.
ryan: For rollout, let's canary trace hook in prod at 10% traffic. Need explicit CRs for the instrumentation PRs. @alex ping @sam for dashboard review when ready.
alex: will do. ETA for initial dashboard widgets: Wed EOD. I'll drop the PR link here when it's up.
sophia: tiny add — update on-call runbook with steps for when retention compaction triggers and how to pull archived traces.
maria: summarizing owners/actions so nothing slips: alex (dashboards), ben (trace hooks + query proto), priya (error analysis/grouping), carla (storage cost + infra caveats), ryan (canary plan + rollout), sophia (runbook updates). Proposed feature flag: console_obs_v2_rollout — agree?
priya: agree, I'll add grouping rules and examples. ETA Thu.
sam: I can review the dashboards PR, ping me early and I'll fast-turn.
carla: suggested retention config snippet to include in the infra PR: ```yaml
retention:
  hot_days: 90
  cold_days: 275
  archive: true
``` I'll follow up with storage class & lifecycle details.
maria: one last Q — any compliance/security blockers for 365-day archive? @olivia?
olivia: no blockers conceptually but require encryption-at-rest + access audit trail + KMS key policy. Add RBAC rules in the PR and ping me for a short compliance review.
maria: perfect. I'll consolidate owners and action items into a doc and share the link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
